svg.title: Implemented S3-S4 - atomic scheduling and immutable replacements

g.text: Implemented S3-S4 - atomic scheduling and immutable replacements
reject nested writes; read latest values
capture Clock instant into fixed DomainTime
reject duplicate ID / non-Pending / catalog mismatch
validate proposed slot; copy spec, retain State/subtype
exclude only original ID from immutable schedule
intrinsic spec validation; raw interval conflict check
validate buffer and effective working hours/conflicts
finally unlocks on success or failure.
find/history/reservations use the same lock and immutable values.
transition delegates finite command to latest Appointment/State,
then replaces reservation preserving buffer under the same lock.
S4 records events/revisions under this lock.
Dispatcher delivers outside it; see booking sequence.
